reasoning: Decorative vase for dried flowers. Cosmetic, no load, no fit, indoor. The outside is what shows. 120 mm tall, 60×60 mm footprint, 2× slenderness, no overhang, no bridge, 1.98 mm section, 48 622 mm³ volume. A flat top of 2825 mm² (the rim or a closed mouth). Success is surface quality on the exterior; failure is infill ghosting, visible layer lines, or a wobbly print.

changes.reason: The section is 1.98 mm and the outside is the visible surface; at 2 loops (0.8 mm of wall) the 15% infill ghosts through. 3 loops (1.2 mm) closes that gap and gives a clean exterior.
The outside is what shows on a cosmetic piece; 0.16 mm is inside the optimal 0.08–0.32 mm band and cuts the visible step lines on the curved wall roughly in half versus 0.20 mm.

The exterior is the finished surface; slowing the outer wall from 160 to 120 mm/s gives the nozzle more residence time per line, reducing stringing and surface irregularity on the face the viewer sees.

design_notes: No overhang and no bridge (both 0 mm²); the vase prints free-standing with no support. Nothing to design out.
